title: Build a confinement policy — policy
text: best_effort TRUE (default), layers kernel provide skipped reported. FALSE, applying policy fails instead. log Landlock audit logging (kernel ABI 7): NULL keeps kernel default, TRUE also logs denials exec(), FALSE turns logging denials . p policy. read, write, exec, rw Character vectors paths. bind, connect Integer vectors TCP ports may bound connected . signal, abstract_unix Logical: scope signals, abstract Unix sockets. memory, cpu, fsize, nofile, pids, core, stack, data, memlock Resource ceilings; NULL leaves resource alone. uid, gid User group, numeric ids names. profile Name AppArmor profile.

title: Build a confinement policy — policy
text: object class lk_policy.

title: Build a confinement policy — policy
text: Layers map : fs(): Landlock filesystem rules. Calling puts whole filesystem Landlock: everything listed denied. read allows reading files listing directories, write allows creating, writing, renaming removing (imply read), exec allows executing (reading, loader needs), rw read plus write. Rules apply path everything beneath . Paths must exist policy applied, built. net(): Landlock TCP rules (kernel ABI 4). Calling restricts TCP bind() connect() listed ports; net() alone blocks . UDP Unix sockets affected. scope(): Landlock scopes (ABI 6): signals , abstract Unix socket connections , processes outside sandbox. limits(): resource limits. ceiling: current hard limit already lower kept. memory limits address space (RLIMIT_AS), pids number processes user (RLIMIT_NPROC), cpu CPU seconds, fsize largest file, nofile number open files. Sizes accept numbers bytes strings "512m" "2g". ids(): switch another user group (root ). Applied every layer except resource limits. apparmor(): change AppArmor profile, unix::eval_safe(profile =) .

title: Build a confinement policy — policy
code: p <- policy() |>   fs(read = c(R.home(), .libPaths()), write = tempdir()) |>   net() |>   limits(memory = "2g", nofile = 256) p #> <landlock policy> best effort  #>   fs read   /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R, /home/runner/work/_temp/Library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/site-library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/library #>   fs write  /tmp/Rtmp7UXASl #>   tcp       bind: none; connect: none #>   limits    as=2 GiB, nofile=256

title: Resource limits — rlimit

title: Resource limits — rlimit
text: resource soft limit (cur), kernel enforces, hard limit (max), ceiling soft limit. unprivileged process may set soft limit anywhere hard limit may lower hard limit, irreversibly. Setting cur current max also tries raise max, privileged process may . : maximum size virtual address space, bytes. core: maximum size core dump. cpu: CPU time seconds; process receives SIGXCPU soft limit. data: maximum size data segment. fsize: largest file process may create. memlock: bytes memory may locked RAM. nofile: one largest file descriptor number. nproc: processes real user id; enforced root. stack: maximum stack size.
